_note: Pre-registered before the first run (2026-11-18). Do not tune these values to obtain a desired curve shape (PRD 5).
dataset: sklearn.datasets.load_digits (copy of UCI Optical Recognition of Handwritten Digits test set; Alpaydin & Kaynak 1998, CC BY 4.0, DOI 10.24432/C50P49)
scaling: StandardScaler fitted on the training split only
training_loop: one partial_fit call over the full training split per epoch; accuracy measured on train and test after every epoch; the test split is never used for fitting, scaling or model selection
